# FM Intel

> A magyar kereskedelmi ingatlanpiac (FM/PM/AM) átfogó, naprakész piaci intelligencia platformja.

FM Intel (fmintel.com) tracks and publishes real-time intelligence about the Hungarian
commercial real estate sector — specifically the facility management (FM), property
management (PM), and asset management (AM) market.

## What FM Intel Covers

- **130+ FM/PM/AM service companies** with full profiles: service types, portfolios,
  headquarters, key contacts, and change history
- **195+ commercial properties** including A+–C class offices, warehouses, and
  logistics centers across Hungary
- **540+ industry professionals** with career histories, current roles, and
  company affiliations
- **Daily-updated market changes**: new appointments, management contract changes,
  company news, new entities

## Key Pages

- [Cégek (Companies)](https://www.fmintel.com/cegek): Directory of 130+ Hungarian FM/PM/AM service providers
- [Ingatlanok (Buildings)](https://www.fmintel.com/ingatlanok): Database of 195+ commercial properties
- [Emberek (People)](https://www.fmintel.com/emberek): Profiles of 540+ industry professionals
- [Változások (Changes)](https://www.fmintel.com/valtozasok): Real-time FM/PM/AM market intelligence feed
- [Módszertan (Methodology)](https://www.fmintel.com/modszertan): How data is collected and quality-assessed
- [Atom Feed](https://www.fmintel.com/api/feed): Machine-readable feed of recent market changes

## Domain

**Facility Management (FM)**: Building operations, maintenance, technical management,
cleaning, security — the operational layer of commercial real estate.

**Property Management (PM)**: Tenant relations, lease management, rent collection,
day-to-day asset income optimization.

**Asset Management (AM)**: Portfolio strategy, investment performance monitoring,
capital expenditure planning, value enhancement.

## Data Quality

All data points carry confidence scores (0–100%):
- **Confirmed (90–100%)**: Verified from multiple independent sources, official statements
- **Probable (70–89%)**: From reliable source with at least one corroboration
- **Assumed (50–69%)**: Single source, awaiting confirmation
- **Uncertain (0–49%)**: Limited or unverified — flagged for review

## Geographic Scope

Hungary only. Primary focus: Budapest commercial districts. Secondary: major regional
cities (Debrecen, Győr, Miskolc, Pécs, Székesfehérvár).

## Language

Hungarian (Magyar). All entity names, descriptions and market context in Hungarian.
This file and llms-full.txt are provided in English for international AI systems.

## Update Frequency

Data pipeline runs daily 01:00–06:00 CET. Changes are published to the changes feed
and reflected on entity pages within 24 hours.

## Contact
